title: To reauthorize the Fort Peck Reservation Rural Water System Act of 2000.
official_summary: This bill reauthorizes through FY2028 the planning, design, and construction of the Assiniboine and Sioux Rural Water System and the Dry Prairie Rural Water System, both located in Montana.

summary.headline: Law extends federal support through 2028 for building two rural water systems in northeastern Montana, including one serving the Fort Peck Reservation.
summary.what_it_does: This law renews the authority under the Fort Peck Reservation Rural Water System Act of 2000 through fiscal year 2028. It allows continued planning, design, and construction of the Assiniboine and Sioux Rural Water System and the Dry Prairie Rural Water System, both in Montana.

who_it_affects.group: Assiniboine and Sioux Tribes of the Fort Peck Reservation
who_it_affects.how: Work on the rural water system serving the reservation can continue to be authorized through fiscal year 2028.

who_it_affects.group: Rural residents in northeastern Montana outside the reservation
who_it_affects.how: Planning and construction of the Dry Prairie Rural Water System can continue under federal authority through fiscal year 2028.

summary.when_it_takes_effect: Enacted September 25, 2026; authorization runs through fiscal year 2028.
